```{=html}
<style>
.w054 { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w054 .w054-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(96px, 1.2fr) repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; align-items: stretch;
}
.w054 .w054-head { text-align: center; font-weight: 700; align-self: end; line-height: 1.2; font-size: 0.8rem; }
.w054 .w054-rowlab {
  display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 6px; font-weight: 600;
  border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px;
}
.w054 .w054-rowlab.w054-rowok { border-color: #2e7d32; color: #2e7d32; }
.w054 .w054-rowlab.w054-rowbad { border-color: #d81e2e; color: #d81e2e; }
.w054 button.w054-cell {
  min-height: 38px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); padding: 0;
}
.w054 button.w054-cell.w054-on { background: #d81e2e; border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w054 .w054-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w054 button.w054-btn {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w054 .w054-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w054 .w054-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w054 .w054-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w054 .w054-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w054 .w054-expl { font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32; padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px; }
</style>
<div class="w054 iw" id="w054">
  <div class="w054-grid"></div>
  <div class="w054-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w054-btn w054-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w054-btn w054-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w054-btn w054-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w054-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w054-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w054-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    Linux is the monolithic kernel with a UNIX/POSIX interface, and the only one of the three that runs Linux containers on its own kernel, because its namespaces and cgroups enforce the isolation. Windows (NT) and macOS (XNU) are hybrid designs layering an outer service layer over a small core, and XNU&rsquo;s BSD layer also presents a UNIX/POSIX interface &mdash; which is why Docker Desktop must run a small Linux VM on both &mdash; see <a href="#sec-05-the-kernel">the section on the kernel</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w054');
  const grid = root.querySelector('.w054-grid');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w054-msg');
  const expl = root.querySelector('.w054-expl');
  const COLS = [
    ['mono', 'Monolithic'],
    ['hyb', 'Hybrid'],
    ['nat', 'Runs Linux containers on its own kernel'],
    ['posix', 'UNIX/POSIX interface']
  ];
  const ROWS = [
    ['linux', 'Linux', ['mono', 'nat', 'posix']],
    ['nt', 'Windows (NT)', ['hyb']],
    ['xnu', 'macOS (XNU)', ['hyb', 'posix']]
  ];

  function clearMarks() {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w054-rowlab').forEach(l => l.classList.remove('w054-rowok', 'w054-rowbad'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w054-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function setCell(cell, on) {
    cell.classList.toggle('w054-on', on);
    cell.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false');
  }
  const corner = document.createElement('div');
  grid.appendChild(corner);
  COLS.forEach(col => {
    const h = document.createElement('div');
    h.className = 'w054-head';
    h.textContent = col[1];
    grid.appendChild(h);
  });
  ROWS.forEach(row => {
    const lab = document.createElement('div');
    lab.className = 'w054-rowlab';
    lab.dataset.row = row[0];
    lab.textContent = row[1];
    grid.appendChild(lab);
    COLS.forEach(col => {
      const cell = document.createElement('button');
      cell.type = 'button';
      cell.className = 'w054-cell';
      cell.dataset.row = row[0];
      cell.dataset.col = col[0];
      cell.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
      cell.setAttribute('aria-label', row[1] + ': ' + col[1]);
      cell.addEventListener('click', () => {
        setCell(cell, !cell.classList.contains('w054-on'));
        clearMarks();
      });
      grid.appendChild(cell);
    });
  });
  root.querySelector('.w054-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let okRows = 0, touched = 0;
    ROWS.forEach(row => {
      const lab = root.querySelector('.w054-rowlab[data-row="' + row[0] + '"]');
      lab.classList.remove('w054-rowok', 'w054-rowbad');
      const on = [...root.querySelectorAll('.w054-cell[data-row="' + row[0] + '"].w054-on')]
        .map(c => c.dataset.col).sort();
      touched += on.length;
      const want = row[2].slice().sort();
      const same = on.length === want.length && on.every((v, i) => v === want[i]);
      if (same) { lab.classList.add('w054-rowok'); okRows++; }
      else lab.classList.add('w054-rowbad');
    });
    if (okRows === ROWS.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ All correct — three kernels, one shape, but only one of them runs Linux containers itself.'; msg.className = 'w054-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else if (touched === 0) { msg.textContent = 'Nothing filled in yet — click the cells that hold for each kernel, then check again.'; msg.className = 'w054-msg iw-msg'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet — ' + okRows + ' of ' + ROWS.length + ' rows are right; the red rows have too many or too few cells filled.'; msg.className = 'w054-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w054-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w054-cell').forEach(c => setCell(c, false));
    clearMarks();
    expl.hidden = true;
  });
  root.querySelector('.w054-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    ROWS.forEach(row => {
      COLS.forEach(col => {
        const cell = root.querySelector('.w054-cell[data-row="' + row[0] + '"][data-col="' + col[0] + '"]');
        setCell(cell, row[2].indexOf(col[0]) !== -1);
      });
      const lab = root.querySelector('.w054-rowlab[data-row="' + row[0] + '"]');
      lab.classList.remove('w054-rowbad'); lab.classList.add('w054-rowok');
    });
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w054-msg iw-msg ok';
    expl.hidden = false;
  });
})();
</script>
```
